newsitem.title: USA: California doctors try to restore 4-year-old's arm.
newsitem.headline: California doctors try to restore 4-year-old's arm.

text.p: Doctors ended a 12-hour operation on a 4-year-old boy on Monday morning in an effort to reattach his arm, which was ripped off in an accident at a coin laundry.
They said the next 48 hours would be critical in determining whether Malik Singletary will regain the use of his arm, which was severed above the elbow.
"The skin was torn, the blood vessels ruptured, the nerves torn and the bone was broken," Dr. John Reinsch said after the surgery ended at Children's Hospital, Los Angeles.

The boy's mother, Camille, told reporters her son was at a laundry in Hollywood on Sunday afternoon when he reached into a front-loading washing machine during the spin cycle. She had left him with a family friend while she ran an errand, she said.
A fire department spokesman said the boy's wrist was caught inside the machine and his left arm was twisted off above the elbow.
Paramedics took the boy to the hospital, along with the severed arm, which they packed in ice.
